overview.lead: Shamans support a group with totems, heals and utility, and play as casters (Elemental), melee (Enhancement) or healers (Restoration). Blizzard counts them among the sturdiest classes, with mail armor and a shield.

No raid-wide Bloodlust or Heroism has been announced, and Blizzard made Rage of the Farseer a personal cooldown on purpose.

101.summary: What every Shaman should know before choosing a spec: the Forever changes, totems, the totem quests and the Dwarf Shaman.

steps.text: Weapon imbues last 60 minutes and stack with weapon enhancements, so one cast covers a long session.
Higher ranks of Lightning Bolt hit harder, and shock damage is back to Classic Era values.
Call of Thunder replaces Lava Burst and adds 5% crit to Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. Elemental Mastery is now called Lightning Mastery.
Riptide is a heal over time with a 12-second cooldown and roughly 40% lower mana cost.
The Enhancement tree no longer has Shield Specialization, Two-Handed Axes and Maces or Weapon Mastery, and the Restoration tree no longer has Nature's Guidance or Totemic Mastery.

mistakes.mistake: Planning an Elemental build around Lava Burst.
mistakes.fix: Lava Burst is gone; Call of Thunder takes its place.

mistakes.mistake: Signing up an Enhancement Shaman as a raid tank.
mistakes.fix: Blizzard only says Enhancement can be a temporary tank in small groups, through Spirit Weapons and Improved Stormstrike. No raid-tank role has been announced.

steps.text: Totems have a 1.0 s global cooldown (it was 1.5 s), and persistent buff totems last 5 minutes (they lasted 2), so keeping totems up costs less time.
Use the totem tracker: right-click a totem there to dismiss it.
Save a set with Call of the Elements and drop it in one cast. Call of the Spirits and Call of the Ancestors add more sets.
When the group moves, use Totemic Call: it moves your totems to your position on a 30-second cooldown, so you do not recast them.
Totemic Recall refunds 25% of your totems' mana.
Windfury and Flametongue Totems are buffs now, not weapon enchants, and the two can't both be active.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for Fire Nova Totem.
mistakes.fix: It became a Fire Nova spell that erupts at your Fire totem.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for Tranquil Air Totem.
mistakes.fix: Tranquil Air Totem is gone in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Dropping Windfury Totem for your own Windfury-imbued weapon.
mistakes.fix: A Shaman with the matching imbue gets nothing from the totem.

steps.text: At level 4, the Earth totem quest starts in Anvilmar, Dun Morogh, and rewards Earth Totem and Stoneskin Totem.
At level 10, the Fire totem quest runs from Dun Morogh to Loch Modan and rewards Fire Totem and Searing Totem.

At level 20, the Water totem quest from Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan is the longest chain, about 2 hours through Wetlands, Redridge, Ashenvale and Westfall. It rewards Water Totem and Healing Stream Totem.
At level 30, a short trip to Arathi Highlands rewards Air Totem.

mistakes.mistake: Putting off the level 20 Water totem quest because it is long.
mistakes.fix: It is the quest that rewards Water Totem and Healing Stream Totem, so set aside about 2 hours for it.

steps.text: Dwarf Shaman is one of Forever's new race and class combinations, which brings Shaman totems and Mana Tide to Alliance raids.
Count +1% hit with spells and attacks from Artisan's Precision; it covers both, so it serves Elemental and Enhancement alike.
Leave weapon skill out of your plans: no racial grants it in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Reading a Classic Shaman guide as if it covered Alliance raids.
mistakes.fix: Shamans were Horde-only in Classic, so Alliance raids never had Shaman totems; the Dwarf Shaman is new in Forever.

overview.lead: Elemental is the Shaman caster: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and shocks. Call of Thunder replaces Lava Burst and adds 5% crit to both lightning spells.

points.text: Lightning Mastery, the renamed Elemental Mastery, shortens Lightning Bolt's cast by 0.5 sec and removes Chain Lightning's cooldown for 15 sec, on a 3 min cooldown.
Lightning Overload gives both lightning spells a 10%, 20% or 30% chance to cast a second copy for half damage and no threat.

101.summary: Leveling as Elemental, the core rotation and your fire tools.

steps.text: Start with Convection and Concussion on row 1: your Shocks, Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning cost up to 10% less, and Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Earth Shock deal up to 5% more.
Elemental Alacrity shortens Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning casts by 0.17, 0.33 or 0.50 sec, and Lightning Overload requires it.
Call of Thunder (row 5) adds 5% crit to Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.
Earthbound makes Earthbind Totem immobilize nearby targets for 5 sec when you place it, which lets you kite melee mobs.
Eye of the Storm gives Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning a 23%, 47% or 70% chance not to lose casting time when you take damage.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting Earthbind Totem to root without Earthbound.
mistakes.fix: Only Earthbound makes Earthbind Totem immobilize nearby targets, for 5 sec when you place it.

mistakes.mistake: Saving points for Lightning Overload without taking Elemental Alacrity.
mistakes.fix: Lightning Overload requires Elemental Alacrity, so take it on the way down.

steps.text: Build your damage around Lightning Bolt; its higher ranks hit harder in Forever.
Use Flame Shock on targets that live long enough for its damage over time. Call of Flame adds 3, 6 or 9 sec to its duration.
Cast Chain Lightning on groups: it casts in 2.5 seconds and costs about 225% of a comparable Lightning Bolt's mana for about 145% of its damage on the primary target.
Elemental Focus gives a 10% chance after any Fire, Frost or Nature damage spell to make your next damage spell cost no mana.
Lightning Overload's extra spells come at no additional cost, deal half damage and cause no threat.

mistakes.mistake: Using Chain Lightning as a single-target filler.
mistakes.fix: It costs about 225% of a comparable Lightning Bolt's mana for about 145% of its damage on the primary target, so keep it for groups.

mistakes.mistake: Wasting the Clearcasting state on a cheap spell.
mistakes.fix: When Elemental Focus triggers, your next damage spell costs no mana, so make it a Chain Lightning when several enemies are in range.

chapters.title: Shocks, fire totems and Fire Nova

steps.text: Reverberation cuts your Shock cooldowns by 0.2 sec per rank, up to 1.0 sec at 5/5.
Call of Flame raises the damage of your Fire Totems, Flame Shock and Fire Nova by 5%, 10% or 15%.
Fire Nova is now a spell that erupts at your Fire totem, so place a Fire totem first. Trial by Fire adds up to 20% to its damage and cuts its cooldown by up to 4 sec.
Trial by Fire also makes Magma Totem last 10 or 20 sec longer.
Shock damage is back to Classic Era values in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for Fire Nova Totem on your bars.
mistakes.fix: It became a Fire Nova spell that erupts at your Fire totem.

201.summary: The level-60 build, stat priorities, consumables, the raid and PvP.

steps.text: Lightning Overload at rank 3 of 3 gives a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell for half damage at no cost. Elemental Fury requires it.
Elemental Fury raises the critical strike damage bonus of your Fire, Frost and Nature spells and your Searing and Magma Totems by 100% at rank 5 of 5.
Lightning Mastery requires Call of Thunder. For 15 sec it cuts Lightning Bolt's cast by 0.5 sec and removes Chain Lightning's cooldown, on a 3 min cooldown.
Elemental Reach adds 3 or 6 yards of range to Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Fire Nova.

mistakes.mistake: Following an older build that spends points on Lava Burst.
mistakes.fix: Lava Burst was removed in November, and Call of Thunder took its place.

steps.text: Value crit: Call of Thunder adds 5% to your lightning spells, and Elemental Fury raises the crit damage bonus by up to 100%.
Spell hit comes from Tidal Focus in the Restoration tree (1% per rank, 5% at rank 5 of 5) and from the Dwarf racial Artisan's Precision (+1%).
Treat the spell hit cap as unknown: Forever's cap has not been published. Classic casters needed 16% against raid bosses three levels higher.
Water Shield, a Restoration talent, returns mana when you are hit and, since 16 Oct, when your spells crit.

mistakes.mistake: Gearing for the Classic 16% spell hit cap.
mistakes.fix: That is the Classic figure; Forever's cap is not known yet.

Warcraft Tavern reports two new caster elixirs, Minor Arcane Elixir and Elixir of Cunning (Agility plus Intellect), and flasks brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object.
Buy healing potions from First Aid crafters: Warcraft Tavern says they moved from Alchemy to First Aid.
Plan raid nights without world buffs: warcraft.wiki.gg says they are removed in dungeons and raids.

Resistance Totems cover the whole raid group, and Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance for Onyxia.
Lightning Overload's extra spells cause no threat, and Elemental Reach adds up to 6 yards of range for fights where you must stand back.

When a melee player reaches you, place Earthbind Totem: with Earthbound it immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec, which buys distance for your casts.
Eye of the Storm at rank 3 of 3 gives Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning a 70% chance not to lose casting time when you take damage.
Elemental Warding cuts Fire, Frost and Nature damage taken by 3%, 7% or 10%.
Guardian Totems, in the Enhancement tree, shortens Grounding Totem's cooldown by 1 or 2 sec.

mistakes.mistake: Hard-casting Lightning Bolt while a melee player hits you.
mistakes.fix: Root them with Earthbound first: without Eye of the Storm, the damage you take costs you casting time.

overview.lead: Enhancement is the Shaman melee spec: weapon imbues, Stormstrike, and Lightning Bolts sped up by Maelstrom Weapon.

points.text: Blizzard's notes give Stormstrike 150% normalized weapon damage on a six-second cooldown, while the talent data lists 100% weapon damage and an 8 sec cooldown. Go by the tooltip in game.
Rage of the Farseer raises your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec. Blizzard made it a personal cooldown on purpose.
Blizzard only calls Enhancement a temporary tank for small groups; no raid-tank role has been announced.

101.summary: Leveling as Enhancement, the core rotation, threat and mobility.

steps.text: Thundering Strikes adds 1% crit per rank with all spells and attacks, up to 5%, and melee crits are what trigger Flurry.

Blizzard's 2 Nov notes give Mental Dexterity 50%, 100% or 150% of your Intellect as Attack Power; the 10 Nov talent data still shows 33%, 66% and 100%, so check the tooltip in game. Flurry requires it.
Flurry raises your attack speed by 6% to 30% for your next 3 swings after a melee crit.
Ancestral Knowledge adds 2% Intellect per rank, up to 10%, which Mental Dexterity turns into more Attack Power.
Stormstrike sits on row 4 of the Enhancement tree.

mistakes.mistake: Putting points in Thundering Strikes to open Flurry.
mistakes.fix: Flurry requires Mental Dexterity in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for Two-Handed Axes and Maces or Weapon Mastery in the tree.
mistakes.fix: Neither is in the Enhancement tree any more.

steps.text: Keep a weapon imbue up; it lasts 60 minutes. Elemental Weapons raises your Windfury Weapon effect by 13%, 27% or 40%.
Use Stormstrike on cooldown, then cast Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Earth Shock within 12 sec for 20% more damage.
Spend Maelstrom Weapon on Lightning Bolt: each stack cuts its cast time and mana cost by 20%, it stacks up to 5 times, and it lasts 30 sec.
Use Rage of the Farseer for burst: 30% attack speed for 25 sec, on a 3 min cooldown.

mistakes.mistake: Letting Maelstrom Weapon stacks run out.
mistakes.fix: They last 30 sec, so cast Lightning Bolt before they expire.

mistakes.mistake: Following Stormstrike with more melee attacks only.
mistakes.fix: Its 20% bonus applies to your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Earth Shock within 12 sec.

steps.text: Spirit Weapons cuts the threat from your attacks by 30% unless Rockbiter Weapon is active and raises it by 30% with Rockbiter, so use Rockbiter only when you mean to hold threat.
Keep Lightning Shield up: Shamanistic Focus cuts its cost and your Shocks' by 45%, and Improved Lightning Shield adds 5%, 10% or 15% to its orbs' damage.
Improved Ghost Wolf cuts Ghost Wolf's cast time by 1.0 sec at rank 1 or 3.0 sec at rank 2, and lets you use it indoors.

mistakes.mistake: Keeping Rockbiter Weapon on while someone else tanks.
mistakes.fix: With Spirit Weapons, Rockbiter Weapon raises your threat by 30%, so switch to another imbue.

steps.text: Value melee crit: Flurry gives 6%, 12%, 18%, 24% or 30% attack speed after a melee crit.

overview.lead: Restoration is the Shaman healer: Healing Wave, Chain Heal and healing totems, with Riptide at the bottom of the tree.

points.text: Forever adds Water Shield, an 11-point talent that returns mana when you are hit or your spells crit, and Mindfulness, which lets part of your mana regeneration continue while casting.
Riptide heals 445 over 15 sec with no upfront healing and has a 12 sec cooldown. It also makes your Chain Heal 25% stronger on that target.
Mana Tide Totem is a 16-point talent.

101.summary: Leveling as Restoration, the core healing rotation and your totems.

steps.text: Improved Healing Wave shortens Healing Wave's cast by 0.1 sec per rank, up to 0.5 sec at rank 5.
Mindfulness lets 17%, 33% or 50% of your mana regeneration continue while casting.
Water Shield is an 11-point talent: it returns mana when you are hit or, since 16 Oct, when one of your spells crits.
Healing Focus gives your heals a 23%, 47% or 70% chance not to lose casting time when you take damage, which matters when mobs hit you in a dungeon.
Take Mana Tide Totem when you reach 16 points; the next chapter covers when to drop it.

mistakes.mistake: Trying to keep Lightning Shield and Water Shield up together.

steps.text: Heal single targets with Healing Wave; Healing Way raises its healing by 8%, 17% or 25%.
Put Riptide on a target who will keep taking damage: it heals 445 over 15 sec and makes your Chain Heal 25% stronger on that target.
Use a direct heal when the target needs health now: Riptide has no initial heal.
Use Mana Tide Totem when your group runs low: it restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards for 12 sec.
Keep Nature's Swiftness for emergencies: it makes your next Nature spell with a cast under 10 sec instant.

mistakes.mistake: Casting Riptide to save a target who is about to die.
mistakes.fix: Riptide has no initial heal; use Nature's Swiftness and a direct heal instead.

steps.text: Drop Mana Spring and Healing Stream: Restorative Totems raises Mana Spring by up to 25% and Healing Stream by up to 50%.
Totemic Focus cuts the mana cost of your totems, and of spells that summon or move them, by 5% per rank, up to 25%.
Buff totems last 5 minutes and the totem global cooldown is 1.0 s, so a healing set takes little time to keep up.
Save a healing set for Call of the Elements, and move it with Totemic Call (30-second cooldown) when the group moves.

mistakes.fix: Totemic Call moves your totems to your current position on a 30-second cooldown.

steps.text: Keep a weapon imbue up with wizard oil on top: imbues last 60 minutes and stack with it.
Buy healing potions from First Aid crafters: Warcraft Tavern says they moved from Alchemy to First Aid.
Plan raid nights without world buffs: warcraft.wiki.gg says they are removed in dungeons and raids.
Read the Classic healer list (Flask of Distilled Wisdom, Elixir of the Sages, Major Mana Potion and the rest) as a Classic reference, not a Forever-checked list.

mistakes.mistake: Asking an Alchemist for healing potions.
mistakes.fix: Warcraft Tavern says healing potions moved from Alchemy to First Aid.

steps.text: Place Mana Tide Totem with the group that needs mana: it restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards for 12 sec, on a 5 min cooldown.
Blizzard lists Mana Tide Totem's ranks at 25, 38, 48 and 58.
Your buff totems reach the whole raid: Grace of Air, Strength of Earth, Windfury and Flametongue since 16 Oct. Windfury and Flametongue can't both be active.
Improved Reincarnation cuts Reincarnation's cooldown by 10 or 20 min and brings you back with more health and mana.

mistakes.mistake: Dropping Mana Tide Totem away from the healers who need it.
mistakes.fix: It only reaches group members within 30 yards.

steps.text: Mail armor and a shield help you take pressure while you heal.
Healing Focus at rank 3 of 3 gives your heals a 70% chance not to lose casting time when you take damage.
Keep Nature's Swiftness for the moment a teammate is about to die: your next Nature spell with a cast under 10 sec becomes instant.
Put Riptide up early: it heals over time, not up front.
Ancestral Healing raises your target's armor by 8%, 17% or 25% for 15 sec after one of your heals crits.

mistakes.mistake: Hard-casting heals under attack without Healing Focus.
mistakes.fix: Healing Focus gives your heals a 23%, 47% or 70% chance not to lose casting time when you take damage.
